Console reads of monthly settlement bills (CT-24z listAdminSettleBills / getAdminSettleBill / listAdminSettleBatchItems; B2-09; 01 F-ADM-08; 04 §3.2, §11.2; design/specs/admin-settle-bills.md): SettlementAdminModule.forAdmin mounts the controller on the admin entry only (permission settle.bill or fund.view through AdminOperationGuard, read only, no step-up, no audit, appId from the guard's actor); reads by app_id settlement's own settle_bills, settle_batches and settle_batch_items only; the bill status is derived at read time per 08 BR-FUND-04 月结账单状态 from the latest round (main round = all kind=main batches; each supplement launch = kind=supplement batches sharing platform and created_at; CANCELLED batches take no part) with the injected Clock for scheduled vs settling, not stored; bill-day totals returned as stored (D10-280 ③); items carry user_id only, no phone. Amounts stay integer fen, nothing recomputed. No state change, no lock, no write. x-implementation: planned removed, generated files from pnpm codegen.
